answer: A claim clears only when a real person burns their own anchor. At the departure lantern they spend their last ember and surrender every future right to answer, witness or be paid, unrecompensed and permanent, so one departure carries one head and never a sibling; an agent has nothing to spend, because its anchor is the claim it came for. The scarce input is that unrecoverable exit: unprintable and unborrowable, and each one burns a willing person out of the pool for good, so a farm's tenth head needs a tenth person gone for good, and a public roll names the sponsor behind the column.
